## AsrSession.close() method

Close the session. Commits any pending audio and delivers the resulting finals to onFinal subscribers before resolving, then releases the broker reference (which may then idle-unload the model). Keep onFinal subscribed until close() resolves if the last utterance matters. Idempotent.

**Signature:**

```typescript
close(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;
